warmup.mindset: 60 seconds, eyes closed or soft focus. Name today's goal out loud.
warmup.mobility: Hip circles, leg swings (front/side), ankle rolls
warmup.activation: Kneel-to-stand hip drive reps, then pogo hops (priming the front kick)
warmup.stance: Weighted low lunge hold, 1 minute: tall posture, knees hover an inch or less off the floor. Go straight into form stances.

sparring.conditioning: High-low round kicks, 20 sec each leg. Record your count. Advanced target: beat the intermediate count and chase your own number.
sparring.noContact: Free sparring, continuous rather than point based.

seg3.label: Forms — Choong Jung 2
seg3.detail: Moves 24–27: R #2 Round Kick → R Side Kick in continuous motion without lowering the leg → R Double Inner Forearm Block → L Reverse Upset Punch. Mirrors segment 3 on the other side. Technique drill: Round Kick + Side Kick combo (moves 7–8, 24–25) solo, for balance, keep the leg up between kicks, no lowering.

seg4.label: Board Break
seg4.detail: Start kneeling, stand and front kick, driving the hips. 30 seconds each leg: 5 kicks on the target, then 1 board attempt, repeat. Higher boards and more reps than beginners.
seg4.note: Board level is individualized: the student's own size and ability. Level up only after 3 consecutive first-try breaks. Any miss means stay at the current board.

seg5.label: Self-Defense — Body Lock and Bear Hug
seg5.detail: Shadow Monster in pairs, 60-second turns. The shadow body-locks or bear-hugs. Defender scores 1 for turning and squaring up with arms up, 1 for breaking the arms and escaping. Shadow scores when the defender loses balance and a hand or knee touches the floor. No technique is taught yet. Rounds can run faster and more lively.

dailyChallenge.standard: Rep counts each time a knee drives to the chest. Hands under shoulders, hips level, no piking.
dailyChallenge.phase: Baseline test: establish your own starting number

seg3.detail: Moves 32–35: L Knifehand Square Block → jump switch counterclockwise, R Double Outer Forearm Block → R #3 Jump Round Kick (advance one stance length) → land R sparring stance, R Double Outer Forearm Block. Mirrors segment 5. Technique drill: #3 Jump Round Kick (moves 17, 34) on targets, for precision, full commitment, advance one stance length.

seg4.label: Board Break
seg4.detail: Gloves on. Heavy bag only. Load with the back of the hand at the opposite ear and elbow up. Rotate hip and shoulder, lift the heel slightly and slam it down, drive the elbow at the target, then whip the hand over at the last second so it lands upset and follows through. Not too high, elbow not locked straight. Mental picture: the strike folds the opponent in half like a bow.
seg4.note: Board level is individualized: the student's own size and ability. Level up only after 3 consecutive first-try breaks. Any miss means stay at the current board.

seg5.label: Self-Defense — Body Lock and Bear Hug

seg5.detail: If the shadow lifts you, wrap a leg around theirs like a grapevine so you keep contact and leverage. Back on the floor, set a stance and keep your hips lower than the shadow's.
